title: Handling of NAS level mobility management congestion control

entities.name: NAS level mobility management congestion control
entities.description: Procedure performed by AMF to handle 5GMM signalling congestion by rejecting requests and managing back-off timer T3346.

entities.name: Mobility management back-off timer T3346
entities.description: Timer started by UE when receiving reject messages during congestion control to defer subsequent requests.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State where UE is not registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE
entities.description: State entered by UE when attempting registration update after change in registration area.

entities.name: Emergency services requests
entities.description: Condition where UE requests emergency services or emergency services fallback.

entities.name: High priority access in selected PLMN
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for high priority access in the selected PLMN.

entities.name: PLMN change
entities.description: Condition where UE enters a new PLMN not equivalent to the PLMN where T3346 was started.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request deregistration from the network.

entities.name: Paging message
entities.description: Message sent by network to page the UE for mobile terminated services.

entities.name: NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: Message sent by network to notify the UE.

entities.name: 5GS update status change to 5U2 NOT UPDATED
entities.description: Property where UE sets 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED after registration area change.

relations.description: AMF includes T3346 value in reject messages during congestion control, causing UE to start the timer.
UE stops T3346 when receiving paging message while timer is running.
UE stops T3346 when receiving NOTIFICATION message while timer is running.
UE stops T3346 when entering a new non-equivalent PLMN.
T3346 continues running if UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state while timer is active.
Emergency services requests are not rejected during congestion control.
High priority access requests are not rejected during congestion control.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST messages are not rejected during congestion control.
UE can initiate 5GMM procedures for emergency services even if T3346 is running.
UE configured for high priority access can initiate 5GMM procedures even if T3346 is running.
After registration area change with T3346 running, UE sets update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and enters 5GMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION-UPDATE state.
